literal_meaning: ভারী পদক্ষেপের শব্দানুকরণ (heavy thumping sound of footsteps)
figurative_meaning_en: slow movement caused by bodily heaviness or fatigue
example_sentences_in_bangla: গরমের দিনে দীর্ঘ পথ হাঁটার পর সে থপথপে এগোচ্ছিল।
ভারী বোঝা নিয়ে থপথপে সে বাড়ির দিকে যাচ্ছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: After walking a long distance in the heat, he was plodding along slowly.
Carrying a heavy load, she moved with a weary, plodding gait towards home.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in Bengali to describe laborious movement.
